title: Zoho Analytics REST API - documents, specifications and developer tools
description: Version index. One entry per API version; each entry points at the directory that holds everything for that version - the authored source documents (md, zenesis-oas, zenesis-oas-samples) and the artefacts built from them (oas, okf, postman) - and at its manifest, which lists the domains and API groups inside it.

status_vocabulary.draft: Being authored. Consumers should not build from it yet.
status_vocabulary.current: The version the public documentation describes. Exactly one version is current.
status_vocabulary.deprecated: Still correct, but superseded by a newer version named in `superseded_by`.

sources.md: Narrative reference. One folder per domain, one Markdown file per API group.
sources.zenesis-oas: OpenAPI 3.1 with x-zenesis-* extensions, one file per domain, plus common/zoho-analytics-api-common.json.
sources.zenesis-oas-samples: SDK code snippets keyed by path and method, one file per domain.

generated.oas: Vendor-neutral OpenAPI 3.1, built by tools/zenesis-oas (make to-analytics). oas/common/ is maintained by hand.
generated.okf: Open Knowledge Format v0.2 bundle, built by tools/okf/build_okf.py.
generated.postman: Postman collection and environment, built by tools/postman/build_postman.py.

note: A new API version is added as a new entry with its own top-level directory, copied from the layout of the current one. Existing entries and paths never change; `latest` moves to the new version and the superseded entry becomes `deprecated`.
